body.purpose: Readable landing copy on dark surfaces.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Hero device, CTA and important blue surfaces.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Main Open Chat action for the landing.
components.css: .ds-primary-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.58); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #60a5fa); color: #f8fafc; font: 850 15px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.32); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-primary-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); } .ds-primary-cta:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.24); }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Sticky glass navigation for the premium landing.
components.css: .ds-floating-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 10px 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.16); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.72); color: #f8fafc; font: 800 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.34); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); } .ds-floating-nav a { color: #cbd5e1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-floating-nav button { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.38); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16); color: #f8fafc; font: inherit; }

components.name: Chat Bubble
components.description: Premium message bubble used inside preview mockups.
components.css: .ds-chat-bubble { width: fit-content; max-width: 280px; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #60a5fa); color: #f8fafc; font: 500 15px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 52px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.24); }

narrative.overview: The landing should feel like entering a premium product preview: dark, cinematic, focused and technically refined.
keyCharacteristics: Dark cinematic canvas with controlled blue signal light.
Large confident typography with generous spacing.
Glassmorphism only where it communicates depth.
Chat previews, floating notes and timeline sections that explain the product.
Motion that feels smooth, expensive and restrained.

rules.name: The Signal Restraint Rule
rules.body: Blue glow is for focus, CTAs, chat energy and motion cues. It must not flood every section.

rules.name: The No Gamer Neon Rule
rules.body: Dark does not mean neon. Avoid aggressive saturation, electric outlines and noisy effects.

rules.name: The Hero Owns Scale Rule
rules.body: Massive type belongs to the hero and cinematic CTA. Product details use quieter hierarchy.

rules.name: The Expensive Blur Rule
rules.body: Blur must be rare, large and soft. Tiny noisy blur looks cheap.

dos: Do build on Midnight Canvas, Slate Depth and Deep Navy.
Do use Signal Blue for CTAs, glow, focus and message energy.
Do make the hero cinematic and the rest of the page calm.
Do keep mobile spacing intentional and touch targets large.
donts: Don't make it look like dashboard corporativo frio.
Don't use SaaS generico lleno de degradados morados.
Don't use UI vieja estilo Bootstrap.
Don't create interfaz recargada y pesada.
Don't create diseno escolar o de plantilla basica.
Don't drift into diseno gamer exagerado.
Don't create app oscura con demasiados efectos neon.
Don't ship a landing tipica sin identidad visual.
